findings.claim: The test data setup is duplicated inline rather than using a reusable builder, which could be extracted so the same construction logic can be reused across tests.
Comments in this and other changed files should be trimmed.
The same test data construction is duplicated across this test file and another test file; a shared builder could avoid the duplication.
This constant is already defined in SafeAccountSelector/index.tsx, so it is duplicated; it should be moved to a shared parent Policies/constants.ts file.
This code is hard to read.
The TokenGroupError code closely duplicates the existing Policies/SafeAccountSelector/components/LoadError.tsx component; the existing error component should be reused instead if possible.
Showing the error and retry as a single row causes text to wrap awkwardly and take up too much space; splitting them into two separate rows, one after the other, may look better.
It is unclear whether truncated data has a tooltip or horizontal scroll to reveal the full content.
The component's width appears to differ between the default and empty states, which could cause the layout to jump while loading if the width is not fixed.

It could not be verified in storybook whether pressing Enter after typing a token name that matches a result selects that token automatically, or whether the user must explicitly click the token in the list; this behavior needs clarification.
